title: React v2 Bundle Splitting and Performance Budget
goal: Reduce the React v2 production bundle risk by adding sensible code splitting or manual chunks and documenting a performance budget without changing operator workflows.
scope: Vite build configuration, React route/component loading boundaries, performance budget documentation, and React v2 build/e2e validation.
generation_reason: Review-time npm run build passed but produced a large main JavaScript bundle warning around 2.1 MB minified, which will slow operator console loads and make future UI growth more fragile.

review_findings: cd ui-v2 && npm run build passed with Vite chunk-size warning
ui-v2 currently bundles large visual dependencies and all screens together
React v2 is the active browser release lane

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Focus on bundle splitting and load performance. Do not redesign screens or add product features.
constraints.no_runtime_semantic_change: Operator workflows, API calls, dispatch, approvals, and data rendering behavior must remain unchanged.

success_criteria: The main React v2 production bundle is split so heavy screens or 3D/Cinema dependencies are not all forced into the initial chunk.
Vite build no longer emits the current oversized main chunk warning, or a documented budget explains any remaining unavoidable chunk with measured size.
Critical routes still load correctly under Playwright.
Lazy-loading states are polished enough not to create blank screens or Crash Recovery false positives.
No backend, runner, approval, scope, credential, or report semantics change.

acceptance_criteria: Build output demonstrates smaller initial chunking or records an explicit accepted budget.
React v2 critical routes pass Playwright after lazy-loading changes.
No feature, runtime, scanning, approval, scope, credential, or backend behavior changes occur.

before_promotion: NEXT_TASK.md must contain this task as the single active task.
after_completion: Promote the next true open task into NEXT_TASK.md, or record that no active backlog task remains in NEXT_TASK.md.

out_of_scope: Visual redesign of the operator console.
Dependency upgrades unrelated to bundle splitting.
Changing runner dispatch, approvals, scope/ROE, credentials, or kill-switch behavior.
